tagline: Building stronger businesses for a better future
hero_kpi_rationale: Primary driver of group performance, reflecting the ability to actively invest in resilient growth businesses, notably through Action, a key lever of value creation.

kpis.name: Private Equity Gross Return
kpis.explanation: Semestrial performance of private equity investments, measured by gross return on held assets.
kpis.description: Private equity gross return was 11% over the six months ended September 30, 2023, driven by Action.
kpis.signal: Resilient performance despite a challenging environment.

kpis.name: Infrastructure Gross Return
kpis.explanation: Semestrial performance of investments in infrastructure assets.
kpis.description: Infrastructure gross return was 2% over the six months ended September 30, 2023.
kpis.signal: Moderate performance in the infrastructure segment.

kpis.name: Gearing (Leverage)
kpis.explanation: Leverage ratio measuring net debt against asset value.
kpis.description: Gearing stands at 6%, indicating a prudent capital structure.

kpis.name: Net Asset Value per Share
kpis.explanation: Total net assets divided by the number of shares outstanding, expressed in pence sterling.
kpis.description: Net asset value per share was 1,886 pence as of September 30, 2023, up 8%.
kpis.signal: Strong underlying value per share with sustained growth.

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.explanation: Amount paid to shareholders per share during the first half of the fiscal year, expressed in pence sterling.
kpis.description: The dividend for the first half of 2024 is 26.50 pence per share.

kpis.name: Percentage of Portfolio Companies with Earnings Growth
kpis.explanation: Percentage of portfolio companies showing positive earnings growth over the trailing 12 months (31 companies).
kpis.description: 89% of the 31 portfolio companies show earnings growth over the trailing 12 months as of June 2023.
kpis.signal: High level of operational resilience across the portfolio.

kpis.name: Total Return on Equity
kpis.explanation: Total return generated on equity during the semester, including valuation gains and distributed income.
kpis.description: Total return on equity for the semester was 10%, driven by portfolio value growth.
kpis.signal: Solid return despite a challenging macroeconomic and geopolitical environment.

kpis.name: Infrastructure Cash Income
kpis.explanation: Cash flows generated by fee income and portfolio income from the Infrastructure segment.
kpis.description: Infrastructure cash income amounted to £62 million for the six months ended September 30, 2023.
kpis.signal: Stable and significant contribution to operating cash flows.

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of 79.0 GBp in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of 0.625 Bn GBp in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Proportion of net income distributed as dividends: 12.4% in the latest year.
